notes: Typically the first-limiting amino acid by DIAAS for whey isolate (DIAAR 1.09).
Primary trigger of mTORC1-mediated muscle protein synthesis; about 2.6 g per 25 g whey protein.
Methionine plus cysteine is the limiting pair for many plant proteins, not for whey.
Most abundant amino acid in whey; marketed as glutamine peptides when added free.
Common cheap spiking agent because it is about 19% nitrogen by weight.
